data.name: Isometric Factories
data.detailed_description:
Crash-land into the Planet

After a catastrophic crash landing, you and your civilians must adapt to an unfamiliar world. Begin your journey by gathering essential resources and working alongside the mysterious god of the planet. Explore uncharted lands, manage your population and resources, and lay the foundation for a thriving new civilization.

Research & Development

Accelerate your progress through the ages by unlocking powerful new technologies. Choose between eco-friendly innovations or high-efficiency destructive advancements, each offering unique benefits and trade-offs. Construct research centers to propel your civilization forward and shape its future.

Build Massive Factories & Distribution Networks

Design and optimize compact high-efficiency factories for precision resource production. Establish complex logistics systems using wagons, cars, trucks, trains, planes, and ships to transport materials between your factories. Create storage facilities to store vast amounts of materials, develop intricate roadways, drone paths, rail systems, and interplanetary jumps to support your expanding infrastructure.

Advance Through the Ages

Start from nothing and evolve through a dynamic tech tree that spans multiple eras: from the Stone Age and Bronze Age, to the Steam Age, Age of Information, Space Age, Age of Colonization, and ultimately, the Final Age. Trade with other civilizations, forge alliances, form guilds, and build the first space station in your solar system.

Survive. Evolve. Dominate.

Forge your legacy in a world full of mystery, challenge, and opportunity. Will your civilization rise to greatness, or fall to the unknown?

data.short_description: Construct sprawling factories in the void of space, unlock new eras of technology, and expand your influence from a single planet to the vastness of multiple solar systems. From survival to galactic domination—mine, build, trade, and expand across solar systems.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Something strong enough to use a calculator
  • Memory: 120 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Something strong enough to run MS Paint
  • Storage: 120 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Something that can run noise
